title: Functional Validation
description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**YOUR ROLE**

Lab validation and characterization
  

Attached to the Imaging Validation department, you will join a dynamic and innovative team, an integral part of R\&D, working on projects at the state of the art of image sensor technology targeting various markets and applications.


As a Functional Validation Engineer, you will be involved in validating all the division products. This activity will aim to ensure the adequacy of the functionalities and performances of the product with the specifications by relying on FPGA prototyping first, and on circuit silicon in a second time.


In this context, you will be responsible for developing the validation environment (definition of the tests suite, of the test bench in the laboratory, of the hardware, development of stimuli, automation, documentation). To do this, you will benefit from the different areas of technical expertise of our employees in testing, optics, electronics, mechanics, and software development.


Throughout the validation, you will also oversee the analysis and resolution of technical challenges. Your product expertise may also be called upon to participate in customer support and integration.


To succeed in these missions, you will work in close collaboration with all the different product development teams (Design, Architecture, Firmware and embedded software development), with our application teams in order to provide the best validation solution that will meet our customer's needs.


You will also participate in project meetings, sharing information, actions, and priorities within the team.


Finally, as a member of a validation team, you will reuse existing tools. You will also propose and participate in methods and tools for improvements.


**YOUR SKILLS \& EXPERIENCES**

o Object\-oriented programming languages (preferably Python, C)
  

o Version management tools (git, svn)
  

o Software, Hardware knowledge and debug capabilities.
  

* Knowledge:

o Embedded electronics / computing (real time)
Exp: 7 to 12yrs
  

o Laboratory tools (oscilloscope, signal generator, etc.)
  

o Transmission protocols (high and low speed): I2C, I3C, SPI, MIPI
  

o Automation and/or continuous integration tools (ex: Jenkins, Gerrit, AI tools)
  

o Notions in image processing would be an adding competency.  



ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2025 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.  



  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

title: Engineer - Electrical Engineering
description:
The Electrical Design Engineer within Generator \& Electrical Systems(GES) organization will play a pivotal role in designing, analyzing, and optimizing products within the Gas Power portfolio. This role involves working across various stages of the product lifecycle, from initial design through field issue resolution. The engineer will ensure technical excellence, safety, and performance of electrical components and systems through advanced analysis, innovative design, and continuous improvement.
**Job Description**
===================


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Design and analyze electrical components applicable to LV, MV and HV systems across the Generator and Electrical product portfolio.
* Create design documentation, including single line diagrams, wiring and elementary drawings, loop diagrams, specifications, layouts, and other arrangement drawings.
* Serve as the Lead Design Engineer (LDE) or Lead Electrical Engineer (LEE) on new build projects and act as the Single Point of Contact (SPoC) for the electrical engineering scope.
* Prepare functional specifications for electrical components, electrical interconnections, and interface documents based on sizing studies, contractual requirements, and applicable regulatory codes and standards (e.g., IEC, NEC, CSA, IECEx, ATEX), and reference designs.
* Lead and support new vendor qualification activities in collaboration with GEV Sourcing.
* Perform and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and develop Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to improve product reliability, quality, and performance.
* Support supplier design evaluations and the technical assessment and disposition of supplier offers.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to interpret \& develop Single Line Diagrams and develop wiring, loop, instrumentation, and schematic diagrams. Apply electrical design principles to adapt and improve overall system design.
* Take technical ownership of electrical hardware and systems.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to support project execution and process improvement.
* Participate in peer and design reviews, develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including Controlled Title Holders, analysis experts, and global engineering sites, and contribute to solving complex engineering problems.
* Comply with R\&D processes, local codes \& standards, manage project milestones, and seek peer validation to ensure technical quality and design integrity.
* Support tendering and bidding activities through engineering calculations, technical assessments, and recommendations.
* Embrace LEAN principles and drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING \- Basic Qualifications:**


* Bachelor of Science (B.S.) or Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 0 –2 years of experience in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, Site Installation \& Commissioning and/or Manufacturing Quality Engineering Function.
  

**WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT \- Desired Qualifications:**


* Strong focus on safety, quality, execution, and process/execution rigor.
* Open\-minded, self\-motivated, and empowered to challenge conventional thinking, explore innovative solutions, and take calculated risks.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with team members and customers while contributing to an inclusive work environment.
* Ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities based on business needs.
* Strong organizational and communication skills, with the ability to communicate transparently and deliver project milestones.
* Ability to break down complex problems and develop and execute effective solutions.
* Familiarity with AI tools and a continuous improvement mindset, with an understanding of Lean principles.
* Basic programming knowledge in Python, with the ability to apply it to engineering data analysis, simulation, or automation.
* Familiarity with electrical simulation software and/or power system analysis tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSS/E, and PSCAD.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: AI - Engineer
description:
**About Us:**

  

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

  

We build long\-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND** **RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

**Note:** The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.


We are looking for an AI Engineer with a strong focus on **Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI** to design, build, and deploy intelligent, LLM\-powered systems. You'll work on prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, and fine\-tuning, while building robust backend services in **Java and Python** — with React front\-end knowledge as a plus to help ship end\-to\-end AI features.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy **LLM\-powered applications** — chatbots, copilots, agents, RAG systems, and summarization/extraction pipelines
* Develop and optimize **prompt engineering** strategies (few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, structured output, function/tool calling) for production use cases
* Build and maintain **Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)** pipelines — embeddings, chunking strategies, vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, pgvector)
* **Fine\-tune and evaluate LLMs** (open\-source and closed\-source) using techniques like LoRA/QLoRA, instruction tuning, and RLHF where applicable
* Design and implement **agentic workflows** using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or custom orchestration
* Build backend services and APIs in **Java** and/or **Python** to serve LLM applications at scale
* Implement **evaluation frameworks** for LLM outputs — accuracy, hallucination rate, latency, cost, and safety metrics
* Manage **prompt versioning, model routing, and caching** for cost/performance optimization across multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, open\-source models)
* Collaborate with front\-end developers (or contribute directly in **React**) to surface LLM features in user\-facing products
* Monitor deployed LLM systems for drift, degradation, and safety/guardrail violations; iterate on mitigation strategies
* Implement guardrails, content filtering, and responsible AI practices (bias mitigation, prompt injection defense, data privacy)
* Stay current with the fast\-moving LLM/GenAI landscape (new models, techniques, tooling) and assess applicability to the business

### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* Strong programming skills in **Java** and **Python**
* Hands\-on experience with **LLM APIs** (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, etc.) and open\-source LLMs (Llama, Mistral, etc.)
* Practical experience with **prompt engineering** and **RAG architecture**
* Experience with **vector databases** and embedding models

If you're ready to take on a fast\-paced and rewarding role in the world of network support, apply to join the Kyndryl team today!
  

  

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

Required Skills and Experience
  

  

* Proven knowledge and experience in trouble\-shooting, switching, and routing
* 2\+ years of working experience in Networking
* Minimum CCNP certification or equivalent knowledge

Preferred Skills and Experience
  

  

* Experience with BGP, Software Defined Networking (SDN) based on Cisco ACI, Checkpoint/Cisco Firepower firewalls, F5 load Balancers, NSX

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

description:
The System Testing Engineer is a specialist\-level individual contributor responsible for executing and driving advanced system testing activities for substation automation and protection systems. ------------------------------------------


* **Test Case Design:** Architect comprehensive, high\-coverage test suites for complex protection and control logic.
* **Automation Scripting:** Develop and maintain robust automation scripts to enhance test cycle speed and consistency.
* **Defect Tracking:** Perform rigorous defect lifecycle management, from identification and root cause analysis to final validation.

-----------------------------------------


* **Requirements to Tests:** Generate accurate test cases and automation scripts directly from technical requirements using AI\-powered tools.
* **Validation:** Review and validate AI\-generated automation scripts for accuracy, maintainability, and standard compliance.

----------------------------

* Experience with SCL engineering and IEC 61850 system configuration tools.
* Experience managing complex test environments and high\-volume defect tracking in a specialist capacity.

==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
The Opportunity
  
Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence are fundamental requirements.
  
We are looking for a Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
  
We value engineers who are self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
  
Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems , making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
  
Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
  
Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
  
Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
  
Solve complex problems across boundaries , collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
  
Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
  
Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
  
Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
  
Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience , with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
  
Deep expertise in C\+\+ , including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.

Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:

Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions .

title: R&D Engineering, Sr Engineer
description:
### **We Are**
Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI\-powered products. We deliver industry\-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R\&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow.

### **You Are**


You are someone who looks at a test failure and does not just log it, you dig until you understand why it happened and what it means for the next release. Scripting is not a chore for you, it is how you make repetitive work disappear so you can focus on the problems that actually need a human brain. You have spent enough time in labs or codebases to know that quality is not something you test in at the end, it is something you build into the process from the start.


Data tells you stories. When you see a trend in regression results, you do not wait for someone else to notice, you pull the thread, ask the right questions, and surface what matters. You are comfortable working across teams, translating between what verification found, what design needs to know, and what a release checklist actually requires.


You do not need years of experience to have a point of view. You know when a process is not working and you are not afraid to suggest a better way. At Synopsys, you will work on Embedded Memory IP that powers the devices people use every day, and the rigor you bring to testing and automation will directly affect whether those products ship on time and work as promised.

### **What You'll Be Doing**

* Run kickoff and release meetings across design, verification, and release teams, making sure compliance checkpoints are hit and nothing falls through the cracks
* Execute regression testing on Embedded Memory IP, catch issues before they reach customers, and track results across release cycles
* Analyze test data to spot trends, recurring failures, and process gaps that affect product quality or schedule
* Write and maintain Python and Tcl automation scripts that eliminate manual testing steps and speed up validation workflows
* Coordinate with cross\-functional teams to align on quality gates, release criteria, and issue resolution timelines
* Document test results, failure analysis, and process improvements in a way that helps the next engineer understand what happened and why

### **The Impact You Will Have**

* Ensure Embedded Memory IP on advanced process nodes ships with zero critical defects, directly affecting customer success and market readiness
* Reduce validation cycle time by automating repetitive test and data collection tasks, freeing engineers to focus on complex debug work
* Surface quality and process issues early in the development cycle, preventing costly delays and rework downstream
* Improve the reliability of regression infrastructure so teams can trust test results and make faster release decisions
* Strengthen compliance and traceability across the release process, reducing risk and audit friction
* Enable smarter decision\-making by turning raw test data into actionable insights for design and verification teams

### **What You'll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field
* 2 years of experience in validation, testing, quality assurance, or a related engineering role
* Working knowledge of Python or Tcl for scripting and automation
* Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and communicate findings clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Familiarity with regression testing, release processes, or quality management systems is a plus
* Strong problem\-solving instincts and the ability to work across teams without losing track of details

### **Who You Are**

* You can look at a spreadsheet of test results and spot the one anomaly that matters, not just the loudest failure
* You write scripts that other people can actually read and modify six months later
* You are comfortable running a meeting with senior engineers and keeping it focused without being intimidated
* When a process does not make sense, you ask why before you follow it blindly
* You can explain a technical issue to a release manager in two sentences without losing the nuance
* You stay organized when managing multiple release tracks, test cycles, and compliance checkpoints at once

### **The Team You'll Be Part Of**


Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process.

### **Rewards and Benefits**


We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non\-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.
